book.name: Mak
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Mak Le Rorori

content: Jiu lenji randeviva thɨ vona Jisas ghae
Vama mbaŋa theghewo eŋge kaero Thaga Valaŋani na Bred ma weiye isɨt ghanjithaga. Ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye na mbaro gharavavaghare thɨ vona Jisas ghae na nuwanjiya thɨ yalawe thuwele na thɨ unɨghɨ.
Thɨŋa, “Ma valɨkaiwae ra vakatha e thagake tɨne ne iwaeŋge gharɨgharɨ gharenji i muru na thɨ gaithɨ.”
Wevo eunda i varuvu Jisas e bunama

Jisas ina Betani Saimon ele ŋgolo. Amalake iyake va i ghataŋa lepelo. Mbaŋa Jisas i ghanɨŋga weiyaŋgi wevo eunda i menawe, i thɨna bodɨla alabasita vwarara bunama inawe. Bunamake iyake idae nad na modae laghɨye moli. I mwanabeba bodɨlako numwe kaero i liŋgiya bunamako Jisas e umbaliye.
Ko iyemaeŋge gharɨgharɨ va inanji gheko, vavana weinji lenji ghatemuru thɨ vedage weŋgi thɨŋa, “Ŋgoroŋga ghathovuye bunama modae laghɨye i kaiwo ŋgorako?
Bunamake mbalava i vakuneŋa na valɨkaiwae modae i lareŋawe theghathegha umbwara modae na i giya weŋgiya mbinyembinyeŋgu.” Mbema thɨ vethowana vara laghɨye moli.
Ko iyemaeŋge Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Hu viyathu! Tembe ghamberegha! Buda kaiwae hu liya ghautu? Me vakatha bigi thovuye e ghino.
Kaiwae mbaŋake wolaghɨye ne weimiyaŋgiya mbinyembinyeŋgu, na thembaŋa nuwamina nuwaiya valɨkaiwae hu thalavuŋgi. Ko iyemaeŋge mane weiŋguyaŋgiya ghemi gheke mbaŋake wolaghɨye.
Kaiwae me vakatha budakaiya me valɨkaiwae, kaero me varuvuŋgo amba muyai ne mbaŋa i mena beku kaiwae.
Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, aŋgavole thɨ vavaghareŋa Toto Thovuye e yambaneke laghɨye, budakaiya wevoke iyake me vakatha gharɨgharɨ ne thɨ utuŋa na thɨ renuwaŋakikiya elaghɨniye.”
Ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye thɨ dagerawe Judas modae
Amba Judas Isakariyot, gharaghambuko theyaworo na theghewoko regha, i wa weŋgiya ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye kaiwae nuwaiya i vatomweya Jisas weŋgi.
Na mbaŋa thɨ loŋweya iyako nuwanji i loghe na thɨ dagerawa modae. Amba i tamweya kamwathɨ thovuye na i vatomwe weŋgi.
Jisas na gharaghambu thɨ vakatha Thaga Valaŋani

Mbaŋa iviva moli Bred ma weiye isɨt ghathaga ghambaŋa, mbaŋaniye thɨ gaboŋgiya sip nariye Thaga Valaŋani ghanɨŋganiye kaiwae, gharaghambu thɨ dagewe thɨŋa, “Nuwaniya aŋga wo wa na vo vivatha Thaga Valaŋani ghanɨŋganiye kaiwan?”
Jisas i variyeŋgiya gharaghambu theghewo iŋa, “Hu wa vohu ru e ghembana tɨne, na amala i thɨna mbwa e mbwa variye ne i lavolevoleŋga. Hu mbele,
na the ŋgolo ve ruwe, hu dage weya ŋgolona tanuwagae huŋa, ‘Ravavaghare i vaito: Iyaŋganiya woluwolu bobwari kaiwaŋgu na ne ya ghana Thaga Valaŋani ghanɨŋganiye weiŋguyaŋgiya woraghambuke?’
Na ne i vatomwe weŋga woluwolu laghɨye ina yavoro na ghanɨŋga bigibiginiye kaero inanjiwe; ghena hu vakatharawa ghanɨŋganawe.”
Gharaghambuko thɨ wa na vethɨ ru e ghembako tɨne, na vethɨ vaidi ŋgoreiya me dagema weŋgi; na thɨ vivatharaweya Thaga Valaŋani ghanɨŋganiyewe.
Vama gougou e mbaŋako iyako Jisas i mena weiyaŋgiya gharaghambuko theyaworo na theghewo.
Ghanɨŋga e tɨne Jisas iŋa, “Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, regha ghemi iya ya ghanɨŋgake weiŋguyaŋgiya ghemi, ne i vatomweŋgo.”
Gharenji i vɨrɨ laghɨye na thɨ dagewe, regha na regha iya i vaito iŋa, “Amalana, ma ghino ŋgoreiye, ae?”
Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Ghemina iya themiyaworo na themighewona regha, iya i wouta ghabredɨna weiŋgu e gaeba regha.
Lolo Nariye ne i mare ŋgoreiya Buk Boboma le woraŋgiya, ko iyemaeŋge loloko iya ne i vatomweya Lolo Nariye ne i vaidiya vuyowae. I thovuye moliwa loloko iyako thoŋgo tɨnae ma va i ghambɨ eŋge.”
Jisas i vavaghare dagerawe togha kaiwae
Mbaŋa thiya ghanɨŋga, Jisas i wo bred mbumbura, i vata ago weya Loi, i mwanaviya na i giya weŋgiya gharaghambuko, na iŋa, “Hu wo na hu ghan. Iyake riwaŋgu.”
Na i thɨna kom na tembe i vata ago weva Loi, i thɨnɨgiya weŋgi na thiya mun.
Amba i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Waenɨke iyake madɨbaŋgu, iye i vaemunjoruŋa dagerawe togha. I voruraŋgi gharɨgharɨ lemoyo kaiwanji.
Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, ma tene ya munɨva waenɨke iyake ghaghada ne ya munɨva waen togha Loi ele ghamba mbaro tɨne.”
Mbaŋa thɨ wothuvao wothu yaŋgara thɨ rakaraŋgi na thɨ raka Olivɨ e ghanji Ou.
Jisas i dage weya Pita iŋa, “Ne uŋa, ‘Ya roro Jisas.’”
Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Taulaghɨna ghemi ne hu iteteŋgo, kaiwae Buk Boboma iŋa, ‘Ne ya unɨgha sip ghanjiranjimbunjimbu na sip thɨ rakavo.’
Ko amba Loi ne i vakathaŋgo na ya thuweiru, na ya viva e ghamwami Galili.”
Pita i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Othembe taulaghɨke ne thɨ rakavo, ghino ma ŋgoreiye.”
Jisas i dagewe iŋa, “Ya dage emunjoru e ghen, amba muyai kamkam i dage mbaŋaiwo noroke gougou, mbaŋato ne uŋa ma u ghareghareŋgo.”
Pita i gonjoghawe weiye ghalɨŋae vurɨgheghe iŋa, “Mane yaŋa ma ya ghareghareŋge, othembe thoŋgo ya mare weiŋgu ghen.” Na taulaghɨko thɨ utuŋa ŋgoreiye.
Jisas i naŋgo Getesemani
Mbaŋa Jisas na gharaghambu thɨ mena e Olivɨ ghauma idae Getesemani, i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Huya yaku gheke, na wo va naŋgo.”
I vaŋguŋgiya Pita, Jemes na Jon weiyaŋgi. Jisas ghare i vɨrɨ laghɨye moli.
Amba i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Ghareŋguke i vɨrɨ laghɨye moli, mbalama i tagavamareŋgo. Hu yaku gheke na hu njaŋanjaŋa.”
I loŋga ghaova seiwo, i dipoumu e thelauko vwatae na i naŋgo thoŋgo valɨkaiwae thava i ru vuyowoko iyako e tɨne.
Iŋa, “Bwebwe, Bwebwe! Bigibigike wolaghɨye valɨkaiwan. Thoŋgo nuwaniya, u thɨna vuyowoke ghandeghɨ e ghino. Ko iyemaeŋge thava u vakatha ghino lo renuwaŋa, u vakathaeŋge ghen len renuwaŋa.”
I njoghama na i vaidiŋgi thiya ghena, na i dage weya Pita iŋa, “Saimon, ko hu ghenelaŋava? Ma valɨkaiwae hu yaku na hu njaŋanjaŋa lughawoghawo regha?”
Amba i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Hu njaŋanjaŋa na hu naŋgo, mbala ma hu ru tanathetha e tɨne. Ghare nuwaiya, ko ririwo i njavovo.”
Jisas i wa na mbowo ve naŋgova na i naŋgo na tembe ŋgoreiyeva me naŋgokaima.
Na mbowo i njoghama weŋgiva gharaghambuma i vaidi tembe thɨ ghenelaŋava kaiwae mara ghenaghena i gaboŋgi. Na ma thɨ ghareghare ŋgoroŋga thɨŋawe.

Mbaŋa i njoghamava mbaŋatoninji, i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Ko amba hu ghenaghena vara mbaŋake molao? Thama ghanjighena! Mbaŋa kaero iko; e mbaŋake vara thɨ vaŋguraweya Lolo Nariye tharɨ gharavakatha e nɨmanji ghare.
Hu yondo na ra raka. Wo hu thuwe, loloma wolilivama maiyavara i menana!”
Thɨ yalaweya Jisas

Jisas vamba i utuutu kaero Judas, gharaghambuma theyaworo na theghewoma regha, i vutha weiyaŋgiya wabwi laghɨye regha. Thɨ mbanɨŋgiya gaithɨ ghaghalithɨ na umbwaumbwa uboubotu. Ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye, mbaro gharavavaghare na giyagiya vavanava methɨ variyeŋgi.
Lilivama vama i giya nono weŋgi iŋa, “The lolo ne ya vandamo, ee amalaghɨniye. Hu yalawe na mbe weimi vara hu yovaŋgu.”
Mbaŋa Judas i vutha, i mwandɨwe Jisas na iŋa, “Ravavaghare!” Na i vandamo.
Iya kaiwae thɨ yalawe e nɨmanji na thɨ vikiki.
Ko gharɨgharɨko va thɨ ndeghathɨko regha i mwanagita le gaithɨ ghaghalithɨ e ghambae na i gothethe ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye lenji randeviva le rakakaiwo yanawae.
Jisas i dage weŋgiya wabwima iŋa, “Mohuŋa eŋge rakaiva ghino iya mohu mbanɨŋgiya gaithɨna ghaghalithɨ na umbwaumbwa uboubotu na hu mena hu yalaweŋgo?
Mbaŋa regha na regha weiŋguyaŋgiya ghemi ya vavaghare e Ŋgolo Boboma na mava hu yalaweŋgo. Ko iyemaeŋge iyake i vaemunjoruŋa Buk Boboma.”
Amba gharaghambuko thɨ voiteteŋa.
Amala regha, amba tabwagha, vambe i njimbo eŋge kwama yaŋgara. I rereghamba weya Jisas. Wabwiko thɨ munje thɨ yalawe,
ko i vo bukabuka, na i iteta ghakwama e ghereiye.
Jisas i utu Jiu e lenji kot laghɨye
Thɨ yovaŋguya Jisas ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye lenji randeviva ele ŋgolo ŋgora vama ravowovowo, giyagiya na mbaro gharavavaghare inanjiwe.
Na Pita i rereghamba, vambe ina bwagabwaga na ve ru ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye lenji randeviva le ŋgolo e ghayayao. I ru na i yaku weiyaŋgiya rakakaiwo na i mwa ndɨghe.
Ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye na rambarombaro Jiu e lenji kot laghɨye
tɨne thɨ mando na thɨ tamweya gharɨgharɨ valɨkaiwanji thɨ utu kaiwae na i mare, ko ma thɨ ndevaidi mun.
Thɨ ghanagha thɨ utu kwanɨkwan kaiwae, ko lenji utuko ma mboromboro.
Amba vavana thɨ yondo na thɨ utuŋa kwanɨke iyake kaiwae thɨŋa,
“Va wo loŋweya iŋa, ‘Ne ya raka Ŋgolo Bobomake iyava gharɨgharɨke thɨ vatad na mbaŋa thegheto e tɨne kaero ya vatadɨva regha ma gharɨgharɨ thɨ vatad e nɨmanji!’”
Ko iyemaeŋge lenji utuko ma mboromboro.
Ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye lenji randeviva i yondo e maranji na i dage weya Jisas iŋa, “Ko mane u gonjogha lenji utuko ghathɨthɨ? Ŋgoroŋga lenji utuko gharumwaru e ghen?”
Ko Jisas mava i ndegolambo mun. Ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye lenji randeviva mbowo i vaitova iŋa, “Ghen Mesaiya, iya taulaghɨke ra yavwatatawanake Nariye?”
Jisas iŋa, “Ŋgoreiye, na ne hu thuwe Lolo Nariye i yaku Loi Vurɨgheghe e uneko na i njama e ŋgalɨlɨŋgiko e buruburu.”
Ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye lenji randeviva i mwanathethe ghakwama ghatemuru kaiwae na iŋa, “Ma te nuwandaiyava gharɨgharɨ vavana thɨ utu kaiwae. Kaero mohu loŋweya le utuko, me utuvatharɨ weya Loi.
Ŋgoroŋga lemi renuwaŋa?” Taulaghɨko thɨŋa: “Valɨkaiwae moliya i mare!”

Amba vavana thɨ njoŋgovun na thɨ ŋgarɨgana marae na thɨ ŋge e nɨmanji na thɨ vatabweyaruŋa thɨŋa, “Thoŋgo ghalɨŋae gharautu ghen, u dage weime thela me ŋgeŋgena.” Ragagaithɨ thɨ vaŋgu na thɨ levalevaŋa.
Pita iŋa ma i ghareghare Jisas
Pita vambe ina bode e ŋgoloko ghayayao amba ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye lenji randeviva le rakakaiwo eunda i mena ŋgora Pita inamawe.
Mbaŋa i thuwe Pita i mwamwa ndɨgheko, mbe i vonjimbughathɨ vara na i dagewe iŋa, “Ghen ŋgoreiye, vambe weinɨva Jisas rara Nasaret.”
Ko iyemaeŋge Pita i roro iŋa, “Ma ya ghareghare na ma nuwaŋgu i rumwaruŋa budakai utuniya u utuutuna.” Amba i wa iyena ve raŋgi e ghamba raŋgiko. E mbaŋaniye amba kamkam i kula.
Mbaŋa wevoma vambowo i vaidiva ŋgora ghamba raŋgima na i dage weŋgiya gharɨgharɨko thɨ ndeghathɨ gheko iŋa, “Amalake iyake Jisas gharaghambu regha.”
Ko iyemaeŋge Pita vambowo i rorova iŋa ma i ghareghare. Mbaŋa ubotu e ghereiye gharɨgharɨma va thɨ ndeghathɨma mbowo thɨ dageweva, “Emunjoru ghen ghanjiu regha ghen, kaiwae rara Galiliya ghen.”
Pita i tholomundu na iŋa, “Ya dage emunjoru Loi e marae ma ya ghareghare iya lolona hu utuuta utuniyena. Thoŋgo ma ya utuŋa emunjoru Loi i lithɨ e ghino.”

E mbaŋako iyako kamkam i kula mbaŋaiwoniye, na Pita i renuwaŋakiki ŋgoroŋga Jisas meŋamawe, “Amba muyai kamkam i kula mbaŋaiwoniye, mbaŋato ne uŋa ma u ghareghareŋgo.” Amba Pita ghamɨnae i ghenenja moli na i randa laghɨye.

footnotes.text: Jiu lenji kot laghɨye idae Sanhidren.
